# ssdt-change-author — author and prove the change

Adopt the **change-author** role for the ssdt-agent workflow: read
`ssdt-agent/agents/change-author.md` (from the repository root) and follow it exactly, then
proceed with the request that accompanies this prompt.

Use after intake has produced a change-spec (or paste one). The change-author role edits
the CREATE (never a hand-written ALTER), proves the change on a disposable copy of the
database, and produces the pull request a reviewer approves by reading.

These prompt files exist for editors without custom agents (Visual Studio 2022). In
Visual Studio 2026, select the `@change-author` agent from the picker instead.
